decisions.reason: This door lever handle family is very close to the firm's existing capabilities in architectural hardware, so management is likely to retain it and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
The mitred door lever handle family builds on the same design, manufacturing and market knowledge as the core handle business, which supports continued learning and commercial improvement.
Although the multifunctional feature set is somewhat more experimental, it still rests on related handle know-how that gives the firm a good basis to interpret early feedback and improve it.
A standard door lever handle is firmly within the firm's established knowledge base, making it more likely to be kept as part of the portfolio than to be discontinued after one year.
The dedicated product page and German Design Award are strong positive signals that this collection fits the firm's competencies and is gaining market recognition, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The light patinated bronze finish is an incremental extension of the firm's surface and design expertise, so it is likely to stay unless demand proves noticeably weaker than expected.
